title: Readiness Sanity Snapshot — Launch Week Quickscan
content:
Purpose:
A tight, pragmatic checklist and KPI snapshot to be used during the final 7 days before a product launch (beta or GA). Intended for product-ops leads, release owners, SRE on-call, and the launch commander.

How to use this doc:
- Run the Quickscan daily (morning) and capture pass/fail + short notes.
- Any FAIL for a critical item (marked CRIT) requires an immediate cross-functional huddle and either a rollback plan or a mitigation committed in a ticket.
- The doc is intentionally terse — link to deeper runbooks or tickets in linked_artifacts.

Quick readiness score (heuristic):
- For each CRIT item: PASS = 0, WARN = 1, FAIL = 2
- For non-CRIT items: PASS = 0, WARN = 0.5, FAIL = 1
- Readiness band: 0-2 = Green, 2.5-6 = Yellow, >6 = Red

1) Launch surface sanity checks (CRIT items)
- Feature flag & rollout plan in PRD + Console: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL   (owner: Priya)
  Notes: ensure canary percentages and auto-rollback hooks are configured. Link: JIRA:POPS-214
- Critical path API latency (p50/p95/p99) validated on staging against production-like load: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL   (owner: Ethan)
  Thresholds: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms, p99 < 750ms — if any exceeded, attach load test artifact.
- DB migrations are reversible and validated in a dry-run: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL   (owner: Rory)
- Secrets / KMS keys present in target environment and rotation window documented: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Rate-limiting & quota guards configured for free/paid tiers: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL

2) Observability & Alerting (CRIT)
- Dashboards created and pinned to the runbook (latency, error-rate, token-cost per request): [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Pager escalation chain confirmed and on-call notified for launch window: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Synthetic probes for the critical happy path running every 1–5m: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Alert thresholds validated (no fat-finger thresholds that spam): [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL

3) Rollout, fallback & capacity (CRIT)
- Canary plan with explicit stop/rollback criteria documented: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Dedicated capacity / burst plan confirmed with infra (if applicable): [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Fallback model variants and auto-fallback routing configured (hosted/dedicated variants): [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL

4) KPI smoke (non-CRIT but high-signal) — capture current snapshots and target ranges
- Baseline active users (expected first 24h): "target: 500–2,000"; current: "__"
- Error budget consumption (rolling 1h): "target: <5%"; current: "__"
- Cost per 1k tokens (estimated w/ canary traffic): "target: <$0.30"; current: "__"
- Signup -> first request funnel (median time): "target: <60s"; current: "__"

5) Customer & legal safety checks
- Terms + privacy reviewed for new data flows and signed off by legal: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Data retention / PII scrubbing reviewed for beta customers: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL

6) Communications & runbook
- Launch command channel (Slack) created + all owners invited: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Customer support playbook and escalation links published: [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL
- Public comms draft & rollback comms ready (PR + doc): [ ] PASS / [ ] WARN / [ ] FAIL

7) Sticky notes / open tickets (capture the 3 highest-risk unresolved items)
- 1) [ticket key] — short summary — owner — ETA
- 2) [ticket key] — short summary — owner — ETA
- 3) [ticket key] — short summary — owner — ETA

8) Rapid mitigation templates (copy into channel for immediate action)
- API latency spike: scale burst pool -> temporary rate limit -> enable lightweight model variant -> notify customers. (owner: infra on-call)
- KV/cache warmup fail: enable fallback cold-serving path + run cache-pop script -> estimate warmup time -> shift traffic slowly.
- Unexpected content safety hits: enable automated human-review queue + throttle new signups from flagged regions.

Notes & known compromises:
- This doc intentionally excludes deep checklists for infra runbooks and security reviews; link to them from linked_artifacts.
- If any CRIT item is FAIL after 2 successive daily quickscans, escalate to exec on-call and consider delaying launch.

Action items for today:
- Priya: confirm feature flag gating tests are included in the staging smoke suite (ticket: POPS-321).
- Ethan: run a 30m production-like soak with 50% expected peak and attach report to this doc.
- Rory: verify DB migration backward path and post-migration query plan.

Revision history:
- 2024-09-12 created by Maya Chen (initial quickscan template)
- 2024-09-18 updated: added readiness scoring heuristic and KPI quick fields (Ethan)
- 2024-09-26 updated: clarified canary thresholds and added mitigation templates (Maya)

Quick links:
- Confluence runbook: confluence:PRODOPS-4332
- Launch ticket: JIRA:POPS-214
- Canary PR: github:github.com/redwood-inference/prodops/pulls/198

End of snapshot.
